permitFee.note: No registration fee was found for the Florida Business Tax Application for sales and use tax.

penalty.note: 10% of the tax with a $50 minimum for a late return; an additional 10% for each 30 days the payment is late, up to 50%.

unemployment.note: $25 for each 30 days or fraction a required report is delinquent (Fla. Stat. 443.141); erroneous reports cost the greater of $50 or 10% of the tax, up to $300.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: No current official penalty amount for lacking required coverage was found; secondary sources conflict.
